queries_run: Marriott International market share gaining OR losing 2026 RevPAR vs peers
Marriott International new entrant OR displace threat Lodging 2026 Airbnb hotel

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 列出主要對手（Hilton、IHG、Hyatt、Wyndham、Accor、Choice、Best Western）及 Airbnb/Vrbo 等短租平台作為替代選項；一手紀錄未載明份額消長數字。
findings.excerpt: We encounter strong competition in the short-term lodging market from regional, national, and international chains that operate lodging properties or franchise their brands, lodging properties that are not affiliated with a chain, and online platforms, including Airbnb and Vrbo, that allow travelers to book short-term rentals of homes and apartments as an alternative to hotel rooms.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：新增客房供給可能壓抑部分市場的房價與入住率。
findings.excerpt: Further, new lodging supply in individual markets could have a negative impact on the hotel industry and hamper our ability to maintain or increase room rates or occupancy in those markets.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 2026 搜尋未找到直接的 Marriott vs 同業 RevPAR 份額比較，也未見 2026 新進入者／替代供應商搶單的來源；2026 Q2 全球 RevPAR +3.4%（美加 +5.0%、國際 -0.5%）見 Hotel Dive 線索。

clues.claim: Marriott 2026 Q2 全球 RevPAR 成長 3.4%，美加 5.0%，國際 -0.5%
